turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I'm listening, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
Go ahead. I'm writing this down, so say it slowly. What do you have?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
I'm writing down 11:31 PM. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
I'm writing down those times and those numbers. People paste from their own notes, Hale, and nobody spoke to Owen before this went in, which is procedure 4.1. What else do you have?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't manage me, Hale. What else do you have?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.

I'm writing that line down word for word. Students misquote Hamlet from memory every year, Hale, and a misquote isn't a process. I'll check it against the play myself, and I'll want your three editions in writing.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Save it, Hale. You haven't answered who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me first.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
I'm writing down October 15. Changing your argument between an outline and an essay is called revising, Hale. Put that outline in front of me.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

That's software, Hale, and Turnitin's own guide says its indicator "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student." Procedure 4.3 says the same thing about detection software. So what's on paper besides a number?
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Off the record doesn't exist in this room, Hale. Are you asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, and then we'll talk about what you have.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing, tonight, with nothing on his record. A rewrite for what, though? I haven't seen the outline or your three editions.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? That's a strange thing to ask in this room, and I have ten minutes. Owen's essay, Hale.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
Go ahead, Hale. I'm going to the principal myself when we're done, and your threat goes in my notes. Does the zero come off while you decide, yes or no?
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. The zero comes off, Hale, and then you show me your documents.
